decisions.reason: As a multi-model line with its own dedicated page in both years, the aloe vera line represents substantial investment and visible public commitment, so management would persist with it rather than write it off.

The hyaluronic serum is close to the core offer and has stayed listed for two years, so dropping it would release little and would require justifying the earlier decision, which favours keeping it despite its modest visibility.
The cleansing oil was launched only in 2024 and partly fills the gap left by the withdrawn cleansing milk, so any weak early results can still be attributed to the start-up phase and it is kept.
